data.name: Airship Climber
data.detailed_description:
Climb together. Fall together. Make it to the top and Become king... if your friends let you.

Airship Climber is a chaotic co-op climbing game where you and your team battle your way upward across airships, floating debris, and unstable platforms in a sky full of danger. Grab, jump, swing, and scramble through a vertical obstacle course while bombs rain down and explosions turn every climb into chaos.

The goal is simple: reach the top and claim the crown.

But staying there is another story.

At the summit sits a throne. The first player to claim the crown becomes king and must survive for one full minute while everyone else does everything they can to bring them down. Bombs fall, platforms shake, friendships collapse, and one small mistake can send everyone tumbling.

Win the crown, survive the chaos, and ascend into one of two spectator portals. Return as an angel or devil and rain coins or bombs onto the battlefield while the next struggle for the throne begins.

Every match becomes a story of near-victories, sudden betrayals, clutch recoveries, and spectacular wipeouts.

Key Features

  • Chaotic Co-op Climbing
    Simple, physics-driven movement makes every jump, grab, and mistake matter.

  • King of the Hill Finale
    Reach the throne, claim the crown, and survive one minute against everyone else.

  • Angel or Devil Spectator Mode
    Winners return to the skies as playful spectators who throw coins or bombs.

  • A World That Fights Back
    Bombs fall, explode, and disrupt your path, creating unpredictable moments every run.

  • Built for Replayability
    Short, high-energy sessions filled with unique, emergent chaos.

  • Global Leaderboards
    Track your best runs and compete for the highest loot totals.

Every Run Tells a Story

From last-second saves to total team wipeouts, Airship Climber is built around moments you’ll want to share.

Because in the end It’s not about reaching the top. It’s about everything that goes wrong along the way.
